main_text.head: CLAVDIO CVSSÆO LVRBINIO NOBILI GALLO, Geneuensium militum præfecto: ab expugnatione Clusæ in urbem reuertenti 21. Apr. 1590.

p.i: VOte decorum puluere Lurbini Recente cerno? Quæ noua nunc tuæ Laurus cohortu cingit umbra Conspicuas viridante frontes?
Quo læta chari murmure nuntij Cunctis sonoros ædibus integrat Geneua plausus: perque templa Turba frequens Superum Parentem Non uisitatis laudibus euehit?
Arces reuulsas te duce rupibus Audit tremendis, & patere Claustra tuo superata marte.
Quæ fastuoso Regulus Allobrox Fidens Iberum fœdere struxerat, Tetrisque Iurassi rigentis Abdita munierat cauernis, Non caciores incoluit specus

page.notes: The decorated initial Q is not transcribed as text. Some letters in the ornamental heading and verse are uncertain ("Clusæ" possibly "Clusæ"; "Immane" appears at right margin level with the last line and may be the start of the next catchword-like line). The first line of the poem reads "VOte" as printed, possibly "Vo te" after the Q initial.
